research_brief.decision_context: Test the FY2025 liquidity and asset-value premises before a screening view
research_brief.authorization_basis: The owner's Task 9.4 instruction to qualify the deep-research pathway on the VMO2 releases
research_brief.exclusions: No web or model-memory sources; no trade recommendation; no figure outside the two supplied releases

questions.question: What cause did the issuer state for the non-cash goodwill impairment it recorded in Q4 2025?
questions.decision_relevance: Separates a market-driven write-down from an asset-specific one in the screening view
questions.evidence_needed: The issuer's own statement of the impairment and its cause in the Q4 2025 release
questions.completion_test: The stated cause quoted from the release, with the amount and any contrary statement searched for

questions.question: What maximum undrawn commitments did the issuer report at 31 December 2025?
questions.decision_relevance: Sets the liquidity headroom the screening view assumes
questions.evidence_needed: The issuer's own year-end undrawn-commitments disclosure
questions.completion_test: The reported amount and date quoted from the release, with the Q3 figure searched as contrary evidence

questions.question: What corporate family rating and outlook does Moody's currently assign the issuer?
questions.decision_relevance: Would set the rating-sensitivity assumption of the screening view
questions.evidence_needed: A current rating agency publication or an issuer disclosure naming the rating
questions.completion_test: A dated rating and outlook from a named agency, or the question recorded UNRESOLVED
